31379400.clinical_problem: quantifying cranial malformations in craniosynostosis patients using radiation-free 3D photography instead of CT
31379400.patient_population: 17 craniosynostosis patients compared with a normative population
31379400.model_description: a landmark-based registration method takes a 3D photograph of the head as input and outputs a quantified cranial malformation score relative to a normative statistical shape atlas built from healthy 3D photographs

31741549.clinical_problem: quantifying association between cumulative subconcussive head impact exposure and white matter integrity changes in youth and high-school football players
31741549.patient_population: youth and high school football players, ages 9-18, imaged pre- and post-season
31741549.model_description: a 3D CNN takes the change in fractional anisotropy DTI maps (pre- to post-season) as input and outputs a classification of players into high vs. low cumulative head-impact-exposure groups
31741549.study_design: prospective single-season cohort study with 3D CNN classification

28163680.clinical_problem: automatically segmenting brain MRI structures across the life course, including newborns and children, to study brain development
28163680.patient_population: 179 individuals: newborns (38-42 weeks GA), children/adolescents (4-17 years), adults (35-71 years)
28163680.model_description: a sliding-window multi-class random forest classifier takes brain MRI as input and outputs automatic segmentation, trained to generalize across newborn, child, and adult ages
28163680.study_design: retrospective algorithm development study across the life course

28487114.exclusion_reason: no AI/ML component; graph-theoretical statistical comparison of structural connectivity metrics between groups, not a trained classifier or predictive model

28818743.clinical_problem: classifying neonatal brain conditions (term controls vs. intrauterine growth restriction vs. ventriculomegaly) from neuroimaging
28818743.patient_population: neonates in three groups: term controls, intrauterine growth restriction, and mild isolated ventriculomegaly
28818743.model_description: a neighborhood-approximation random forest combined with manifold learning takes multiple distance measures derived from neonatal MRI as input and outputs a classification among term, IUGR, and ventriculomegaly groups

27684324.clinical_problem: detecting bowing (plastic deformation) fractures on pediatric forearm radiographs to reduce missed diagnoses
27684324.patient_population: 226 pediatric forearm cases with bowing fractures vs. normal controls
27684324.model_description: a computer-aided detection system takes a plain forearm radiograph as input and outputs detection/quantification of bowing fracture, with a GUI for emergency-department use

27747592.clinical_problem: identifying discriminative neuroimaging biomarkers to characterize/classify ADHD
27747592.model_description: an integrated feature-ranking and Lasso feature-selection framework takes normalized brain cortical thickness features from MRI as input and outputs a set of discriminative markers used to classify ADHD vs. healthy controls

25547431.exclusion_reason: no AI/ML component; narrative review of bilirubin-induced neurologic dysfunction pathophysiology, AI/advanced MRI mentioned only as a future research direction

18334444.clinical_problem: predicting development of cerebral palsy in preterm infants from early quantitative cranial ultrasound texture
18334444.patient_population: very preterm infants imaged within one week of birth
18334444.model_description: a random forest classifier takes quantitative texture features from early cranial ultrasound as input and outputs a prediction of subsequent cerebral palsy
18334444.headline_result: 72% match to CP vs. no-CP outcome, vs. 53% baseline error from labeling all patients CP

16824973.clinical_problem: differentiating chemotherapy-induced leukoencephalopathy from normal maturation in children treated for acute lymphoblastic leukemia
16824973.patient_population: 228 children treated for acute lymphoblastic leukemia, imaged at multiple time points
16824973.model_description: a Kohonen self-organizing map takes multi-sequence MRI (T1, T2, PD, FLAIR) and tissue volume maps as input and outputs a computer-aided classification of white matter regions as leukoencephalopathy vs. normal-appearing
16824973.headline_result: agreement with consensus of two trained observers 84.1% (535/636)

39814054.clinical_problem: reviewing predictors, including machine learning models and lung ultrasound, and outcomes of extubation failure in preterm neonates
39814054.patient_population: preterm neonates less than 37 weeks gestation, 120 studies included from 8,336 screened
39814054.model_description: systematic review and meta-analysis of predictors (including machine learning models and lung ultrasound scores) of extubation failure in preterm neonates and its association with mortality/bronchopulmonary dysplasia
39814054.headline_result: extubation failure associated with mortality/BPD: pooled OR 4.7 (95% CI 2.84-7.76)

39888426.exclusion_reason: quantitative MRI technique (synthetic MR/MDME mapping), not a machine learning model; AI mentioned only in passing as a potential future data source

39915247.exclusion_reason: not primarily imaging-focused; pharmacotherapy review of major depressive disorder in which neuroimaging and machine learning are mentioned only as one of several precision-psychiatry approaches, not pediatric-specific

39937388.exclusion_reason: non-radiologic imaging; dental panoramic radiograph forensic age estimation, explicitly excluded category

39993372.clinical_problem: reconstructing detailed 3D blood flow velocity and pressure fields in the cardiac left ventricle from color Doppler echocardiography, tested using fetal and adult heart simulations
39993372.patient_population: image-based flow simulations of fetal and adult hearts (synthetic data, not patient imaging)
39993372.model_description: a physics-informed neural network takes sparse, noisy 3D color Doppler velocity data as input and outputs reconstructed 3D flow velocity and pressure fields in the cardiac left ventricle

40163724.clinical_problem: establishing reference curves for pediatric lower-leg muscle volumes and identifying small-for-age muscles in children with cerebral palsy
40163724.patient_population: 208 typically developing children and 78 ambulant children with cerebral palsy, ages 5-15
40163724.model_description: a deep learning model takes MRI of the lower leg as input and outputs automatic segmentation of 10 muscles, used to build quantile-regression reference curves for muscle volume by age
40163724.headline_result: 56% of the cerebral palsy cohort had small-for-age total leg muscle volume; 80% had at least one small-for-age muscle
40163724.study_design: cross-sectional reference-curve development study with clinical application

40186652.clinical_problem: whether deep learning-based denoising reconstruction improves image quality and shortens scan time in pediatric body MRI
40186652.model_description: a deep learning denoising reconstruction technique takes radially sampled (PROPELLER) body MRI k-space data as input and outputs a denoised image, compared to conventional reconstruction
40186652.headline_result: SNR/CNR significantly higher with DL reconstruction (P<0.001); scan time per slice reduced from 6.3s to 4.8s (T1) and 5.6s to 4.2s (T2)

40235044.exclusion_reason: AI mentioned only in passing as a future direction; this is a clinical disease review of subacute sclerosing panencephalitis, not about AI in radiology

40349546.clinical_problem: scoping review of machine learning approaches distinguishing viral from bacterial pneumonia on pediatric chest X-ray
40349546.model_description: scoping review summarizing machine learning/deep learning (predominantly CNN) models that take pediatric chest X-rays as input and output classification of viral vs. bacterial pneumonia, largely using the public Kermany dataset

40367089.exclusion_reason: study protocol for a maternal-health system intervention (SMS-based PROMPTS plus point-of-care ultrasound); not a radiology AI model development/validation study and imaging component is not described as AI-based interpretation
